photoSubjects: A premium realistic lifestyle photograph of three diverse adults on separate yoga mats in a peaceful open wellness studio with greenery and soft peach sunrise light, one performing full-body Tree Pose, one performing full-body Warrior II Pose with extended arms, and one seated in Lotus Pose, naturally arranged with ample separation and all heads, hands, feet and pose silhouettes clearly visible within the frame.
prompt:
Create a beautiful, modern yoga awareness and advertising poster featuring **at least three different yoga poses** performed by diverse people in a peaceful, wellness-focused environment. Show poses such as **Tree Pose (Vrikshasana), Warrior Pose (Virabhadrasana), and Lotus Pose (Padmasana)**, with each pose clearly visible and naturally composed.

Create a calm and uplifting atmosphere with soft natural lighting, greenery, subtle sunrise tones, yoga mats, and a clean wellness studio or outdoor setting. The design should communicate **health, flexibility, mindfulness, balance, strength, and inner peace**.

Include a strong headline such as **“BREATHE. STRETCH. TRANSFORM.”** and supporting awareness text such as **“Make Yoga a Part of Your Everyday Life”**. Add a clear call-to-action like **“Start Your Yoga Journey Today”**.

Use a premium wellness-advertising style with elegant typography, clean composition, balanced spacing, realistic human poses, and a visually appealing combination of lifestyle photography and modern graphic design. Keep the text minimal, highly readable, and correctly spelled. Do not add unnecessary text, logos, prices, or promotional claims.
name: everyday_balance
idea: An airy editorial composition pairs a tall, rhythmic headline with a large framed group portrait. Warm ivory, forest green, a hand-drawn underline and restrained geometric details create a premium, peaceful wellness advertisement.
